instructions: Complete the notes below. Choose NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER from the passage for each answer.
word_limit: NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER
stem_block:
Notes for new employees

Shift pattern
- The pattern changes every four weeks; the new one appears on the staff (15) ........ by the Friday before at the latest

Breaks
- Within a team, breaks are (16) ........ ; the rule exists to protect the production lines

Recording hours
- Coming in and going out, lunch included, is registered with the (17) ........ by the staff entrance

Exchanging a shift
- Ask the supervisor in writing two days beforehand, on a (18) ........ picked up at the staff office
- Both workers still have to meet their weekly hours, and a swap leaving under (19) ........ of rest between shifts is refused

Annual leave
- Time off is booked on the online (20) ........ , a fortnight ahead as a minimum

items.prompt: Shift pattern: The pattern changes every four weeks; the new one appears on the staff (15) ........ by the Friday before at the latest
items.evidence: Shift patterns rotate every four weeks and are published on the staff noticeboard no later than the preceding Friday.
items.explanation: Paragraph A of Text A says that the shift pattern, which rotates every four weeks, is published on the staff noticeboard no later than the preceding Friday; so the answer is 'noticeboard'.
items.flag_reason: Bosluk 'put up on the staff ___' kalibinin ucunda; 'put up' fiiliyle en dogal eslesen yer 'noticeboard' (ilan panosu) oldugu icin parcaya bakmadan da tahmin edilebiliyor.

revision.onceki_prompt: Shift pattern: The pattern changes every four weeks; the new one is put up on the staff (15) ........ by the Friday before at the latest
revision.ne_degisti: 'put up on the staff ___' esdizimi kaldirildi. Ayni belge kumesi cevrimici bir personel portalini da anlatiyor; 'appears on the staff ___' cercevesinde noticeboard, portal ve intranet esit derecede uyuyor, secim yalniz A metnine bakilarak yapilabiliyor.

items.prompt: Breaks: Within a team, breaks are (16) ........ ; the rule exists to protect the production lines
items.evidence: Breaks must be staggered within each team so that production lines are never left unattended.
items.explanation: Paragraph B of Text A says that breaks must be staggered within each team so that production lines are never left unattended; so the answer is 'staggered'.
items.flag_reason: Bosluk 'their breaks are ___ so that no line is left...' kalibinda; vardiya planlamasinda 'staggered breaks' (kaydirmali molalar) is yerinde yaygin kullanilan kaliplasmis bir ifade oldugu icin parcaya bakmadan da tahmin edilebiliyor.

revision.onceki_prompt: Breaks: Colleagues in one team do not stop at the same moment — their breaks are (16) ........ so that no line is left with nobody on it
revision.ne_degisti: Boslugun onundeki 'colleagues do not stop at the same moment' aciklamasi kaldirildi: bu aciklama 'staggered' sozcugunun tanimini veriyordu. Yeni cercevede scheduled, rotated, limited, coordinated adaylari da uyuyor.

items.prompt: Recording hours: Coming in and going out, lunch included, is registered with the (17) ........ by the staff entrance
items.evidence: All staff must clock in and out using the card reader at the staff entrance, including for lunch breaks.
items.explanation: Paragraph C of Text A says that clocking in and out, including lunch breaks, is recorded with the card reader at the staff entrance; so the answer is 'card reader'.

items.prompt: Exchanging a shift: Ask the supervisor in writing two days beforehand, on a (18) ........ picked up at the staff office
items.evidence: Employees who wish to swap an assigned shift with a colleague must submit the request in writing to their supervisor at least 48 hours in advance, using the shift-swap form available from the staff office.
items.explanation: Paragraph D of Text A says that a shift-swap request must be made 48 hours in advance using the shift-swap form obtained from the staff office; since 'shift-swap' is hyphenated, the answer counts as two words.

items.prompt: Exchanging a shift: Both workers still have to meet their weekly hours, and a swap leaving under (19) ........ of rest between shifts is refused
items.evidence: Both employees remain responsible for meeting their required weekly hours, and swaps that would leave fewer than eleven hours' rest between shifts will not be approved.
items.explanation: Text A, paragraph D says swaps that would leave fewer than eleven hours' rest between shifts will not be approved; so the answer is 'eleven hours'.

yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: Annual leave: Someone working full time receives (19) ........ of paid leave a year, with public holidays counted inside that total
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: Full-time employees are entitled to 28 days of paid annual leave per year, including public holidays.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Cevabin kendisi hukukla sabitlenmis bir sayi: Birlesik Krallik'ta tam zamanli calisanin yasal asgari yillik izni resmi tatiller dahil 28 gundur ve not satiri bu kosulun ikisini de ('full time', 'public holidays counted inside that total') veriyor; model uc turda da '28 days' yazdi (3/3 PUAN). Kosullari cikarmak sayiyi bulunamaz yapar. E6 onerisi: B metni A/1 yerine izin talebinin iki hafta onceden yapilmasi kurali - ama o yuva 20'de dolu oldugu icin baska bir paragraf secilmeli.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Eski satir B metni A/1'e capaliydi ve cevap ('28 days') hukukla sabitlenmis bir sayiydi; satir kosullarin ikisini birden verdigi icin sayi disaridan cikiyordu. Yeni satir o cumleye hic degmiyor: kanit A metni D/2'ye, vardiya degisimi kuralinin ikinci kosuluna tasindi ve satir 18. yuvanin dayandigi D/1'i tekrar etmiyor. Not bloguna yeni bir bosluk eklenmedi, var olan bolum bir satir genisletildi; bosluk sirasi 15-20 olarak korundu.
